traits.name: Resistant
traits.text: The roachling skirmisher has advantage on Constitution saving throws.

traits.name: Unlovely
traits.text: The skirmisher has disadvantage on Performance and Persuasion checks in interactions with nonroachlings.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Dart
actions.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
